balls.text: Catch No. 4 for Rovman Powell and Rajasthan Royals need 173 to win! Low full toss outside off, he goes inside out but hits it straight to the safest pair of hands today!
Swapnil goes across again, Sandeep pushes it wider. Swapnil wanted to go leg side but gets it off the outside half and the ball pops to the off side and they sneak a single
Oh, that's a huge hit! Low full toss outside off, he goes across and gets under the ball and wallops it over the square leg boundary
Full outside off, tries to go inside out but miscues it and it drops short of the deep cover fielder

Oh, what was that Jaiswal? Maybe his mind is already on the chase because that was a short ball harmlessly ramped towards him by Karn. It bounces in front of him and just spins away from him and goes away for four
Length ball outside off, slapped down the ground to long-on
Full outside off, Karn looks to drive but can't connect. After going for 39 runs in his first three overs, he takes two wickets and gives away just five runs in this one.
Goes inside out, straight to Powell at deep cover!. Full and wide again from Avesh, Lomror again looks to go on the off side. Doesn't hit it well at all and that's easy stuff for Powell
Sliced over short third! Full and wide, Lomror opens the face and carves it fine on the off side. He got an outside edge but hit it hard enough to clear the infielders
Dug in short outside off, pulled along the ground through midwicket for a single
Dug in short and Karthik gets a top edge as he looks to swat it away. Jaiswal makes no mistake running back from cover. No heroics from DK today!
Goes for the wide yorker, Dinesh Karthik was across for the scoop, but since it was wider, he tried to improvise to scoop it on the off side but misses out altogether
Full around off, Karthik swings it along the ground to long-on
Full outside off, driven out with an open face to deep cover
Full delivery, clipped aerially through midwicket and RCB pick up another brace
Very full on off, dug back out straight and Boult sticks an arm out to stop the ball from going away
Slapped over cover for four! Boult goes short and wide and Lomror makes room and throws his bat at that. Gets it straight enough of the off side sweeper
Full on off, swung away to deep midwicket's right
On a length going across him, Lomror punches it out to long-off
Full on off, Lomror flicks it away between long-on and deep midwicket, but the deep midwicket fielder gets there
Yorker on leg, Karthik looks to squeeze it out and gets an inside edge to the keeper's left for a quick run
ON a length around off, Lomror slaps it away straight of the sweeper cover
Slower bouncer around off, Karthik fends it square on the leg side and gets a quick single
Low full toss on leg, Karthik goes across the stumps and swipes it away through the vacant backward square region for his first boundary
Fetches it from outside off and clears the cow corner boundary! This is tossed up outside off, Lomror brings out the slog sweep and gets it wide of long-on
Swept along the ground to deep midwicket
Tossed full and wide, driven along the ground to long-off
On a length on leg, clipped behind square leg
Tossed full around middle and off, patted towards cover
Full on off, driven back to the bowler
Full around off, clipped wide of long-on
Length ball on off, dropped towards point for a quick single
Full outside off, Karthik steers it through point for a single. No duck for him!

Full outside off and angling in and Dinesh Karthik misses his flick. And up goes the finger as he is hit on the front pad! Karthik reviews. A big roar as the UltraEdge shows a spike as ball passes bat. And the decision is reversed! It did look like there was gap between bat and ball, and the sound could have been bat on pad. Royals are bewildered that wasn't checked! There was clear gap!

Oh no, Patidar picks out mid-off! Parag takes a good catch tracking back. Avesh goes short outside off and Patidar was jumping and trying to slap it down the ground. Came off high on the bat and didn't have enough to clear the fielder
Lovely pickup shot. Patidar now finding his timing. Avesh goes short and across Patidar, who just helps it along its way over the fine leg boundary
Tossed up full on leg, swung away along the ground to deep midwicket
Full and wide, Patidar reaches out and slaps it over cover point. Couple of bounces and four
Tossed up full and Lomror eases it out to long-on

Jaiswal almost holds on to a beauty, but goes over the rope! Thrown up around off, in the slot, Lomror goes for the slog sweep to deep midwicket's left. Jaiswal running across can't hold on and spills the ball onto the rope
Tossed up full on leg, Patidar skips out and chips it towards deep midwicket onthe bounce
Finally, Patidar nails one! Tossed up full on leg, Patidar launches a slog sweep well over the deep midwicket fielder
Tossed full around off, Lomror defends
On a length around off, Lomror goes back and defends

Maxwell's horror season just got worse! No mistake from Jurel this time. Maxwell looks to go down the ground and he picks out long-on. RCB are suddenly in deep trouble. This is an offbreak on a length outside off. Maxwell swings across the line and ends up getting a lot of elevation, but not nearly enough distance. And suddenly, Ashwin is on a hat-trick!

Powell makes no mistake. Takes a good catch backtracking and that ends Cameron Green's knock. Carrom ball from Ashwin, Green gets it off the toe end and skies it. Powell backtracks from cover and holds it high above his head. Ashwin finally has his wicket
Full on leg, Patidar looks to swing it away, but can't time it yet again. Drags it to deep midwicket
Fires it quick and flat on middle, punched out to long-off
Full around off, driven to cover. Green sends Patidar back but the fielder has a throw at the non-striker's end and misses, allowing RCB to take the overthrow
Umpire, duck for cover! Avesh misses his yorker and it turns into a low full toss. Green pummels it down the ground and the umpire has to duck as the ball races away for four
Avesh sticks to his plan of bowling wide yorkers, Patidar digs it out fine on the off side but there's a deep third in place now
Low full toss again, Patidar again opens the face and this time he gets it away finer. Boult can't reach it this time and Patidar picks up a boundary
Low full toss around off, Patidar opens the face and steers it just behind point and gets two as the off side sweeper runs across to stop the boundary
Full toss outside off, Green drives it down the ground to Jurel at long-on
Length ball around off, clipped to long-on
Length ball driven out to the off side sweeper

Jurel shells a sitter! Ashwin goes short and Patidar rocks back for the pull. His timing has been off today and he gets a top edge this time and it balloons up. Jurel runs in from long-off but the ball bounces out of his hands!
Full around off, Patidar plays it back to the bowler off the inside half of the bat
Ashwin sprays this down leg and Patidar lets it go as the wide is called
Quick and flat around off, blocked back to the bowler
On a length around off, Green stands tall and punches it out to long-off
Tossed up full outside off, Green drags it wide of long-on, but not wide enough
Drops short of deep midwicket. On a length around middle, Patidar goes for the sweep but can't time it at all
Chahal tosses it up almost on a yorker length, Patidar digs it out back to the bowler's right
On a length outside off, swatted down the ground to long-off
Chahal goes shorter, and wider, and Green punches it, using his long arms to reach the ball, and it races away past long-off trying to run to his left
That's a biggie! That's gone into the crowd. This is full, stays straight and Green clears his front leg and clears the deep midwicket boundary
Tossed full, eased towards long-on for a quick brace
Goes for the big slog sweep, but misses. This was tossed up around leg and Patidar went for the big shot, but the ball just pops to the off side off his pad
Length ball clipped away through to long-on
Full around leg, clipped through mid-on for a single
Length ball angled across him, he tucks it to short fine leg
Full around off, eased to long-off
Length ball punched out to long-off for a single
Tossed up full around off, Green leans into a front foot defence
Clipped square on the leg side to get off the mark
Full and flat around off, Patidar defends

Chahal gets the big fish! Kohli brings out the slog sweep but it's gone straight to Donovan Ferreira at deep midwicket, who hold on above head height. Chahal tossed up a leg break around off. It was spinning away from Kohli, who was hitting against the spin and just couldn't get enough elevation
Tosses it up around off, Kohli slaps it down the ground hard but it's gone straight to the bowler
On a length on leg, tucked away to deep midwicket. Ashwin starts well
Goes full and quick, Green chips it out to long-off
Fires it down leg side as Green shoulders arms
Length ball angled across Green, who looks to leave and is hit on the pad
Full on leg, driven out to long-off
On a length around leg, Green pushes it out to long-on
Kohli taps him through square leg for a single
Slower bouncer around off, Kohli pulls it along the ground towards deep midwicket to take RCB to 50 in the powerplay
Chipped wide of mid-on and Kohli picks up another boundary this over. This is very full around leg, scrambled seam, Kohli moves leg side himself and punches it past the fielder
Length ball cramping Green for room, but he is able to push it out towards mid-off for a single
Full on leg, Kohli eases it towards mid-off and sprints away for the single
Full ball angling into Kohli, who clips it behind square leg in the gap and gets two for his efforts
Kohli backs away and whacks it over mid-off. One bounce and four. Moved a touch leg side before launching into the drive as Sandeep goes full around off
Full around off, Green defends towards cover
Boult sprays this one wide outside off, Green leaves it alone and then reviews for the wide not given. But the check shows the umpire was correct to not call it one

OH what a screamer! Rovman Powell, you beauty! Length ball and du Plessis swats it away hard and fast. Powell runs in from deep midwicket and dives forward to hold on and give Rajasthan Royals their first breakthrough. Surely a contender for catch of the season. Boult gets the wicket, but it's not his swing that does it, it's Powell's brilliance in the field!
On a hard length around leg, Kohli looks to stand tall and pull it away but the ball sneaks in under the bat and hits him on the thigh. Ball drops to his right and they sneak the leg bye
Boult gets away with that one. It's a full toss around leg stump, Kohli made room and looked to slap it away on the off side but hits it straight to the cover fielder
Kohli whips this full delivery through midwicket and they run well to get two
Pulled away through midwicket! Faf waits on this length ball and swings it away just straight of the midwicket fielder. Again, doesn't hit it the cleanest, but gets the result
Length ball, steered to deep third for a single
Length ball around off, squeezed to the off side for a quick single

Faf du Plessis unfurls the scoop. It wasn't the prettiest, he didn't get it cleanly, but there's no one at fine leg and he gets the boundary. Went across the stumps early and got it off the inside half of the bat
Full outside off, Kohli eases it square on the off side and gets the single
Hooked away for six! Avesh goes short, Kohli gets inside the line of the ball and helps it fine on the leg side and the ball crashes into the ad boards. And out comes the Kohli fist pump
Kohli skips out to a length ball around leg again and pulls it away to deep midwicket. And that's Boult's first two overs gone without a wicket!
On a length around off, Faf whips it wide of mid-on and gets a single
Boult bangs in a bouncer on leg that's angled across du Plessis, who shapes to pull but pulls away late
Full around leg, du Plessis looks to come down the ground but ends up getting cramped and blocks it out to the leg side
Length ball around leg and Kohli miscues the pull. Gets a bottom edge to deep backward square
Full around off, Kohli defends. Ball was swinging into him. Boult getting that prodigious movement

Length ball outside off, du Plessis cuts towards cover and wants the run but is sent back. There's a direct hit at the striker's end, but du Plessis is back safe. The ball deflects towards midwicket and du Plessis wants a quick run, but is sent back, again
Pumped down the ground! This is in the slot, and du Plessis just clears his front leg and drives it back over the bowler's head
Full and flicked away to deep midwicket
First boundary of the day, and of course it's Virat Kohli! Gives charge to Sandeep Sharma first up and attacks this length ball, swinging it away between midwicket and mid-on for four
Back of length and wide of off, Faf looks to cut and nearly chops on!
Full length around off, bunted to mid-off
Swing and a miss! Kohli with that early aggression, skips down the track and looks to mow this length ball on the leg side. But this one goes across Kohli and beats the bat
Pitched up fuller, Kohli blocks towards midwicket
Wicked inswinging yorker, Faf du Plessis falls over as he tries to jam his bat down. Ends up squeezing it behind square
Length ball, swings in sharply and raps du Plessis on the thigh as he gets squared up trying to defend
Length ball on middle, swinging in, du Plessis stands tall and defends
Back of length around leg, Kohli pulls it down square on the leg side and gets RCB underway
Goes the distance! Slower one on a fullish length, Powell lofts it back over Ashwin's head and fist-pumps to celebrate. Rajasthan Royals end RCB's journey in IPL 2024!
Slower one, full on off, Powell can only defend it back
Length ball on middle, 140.8kph, pushed back towards the bowler
Length ball outside off, cut to backward point
Another edge and another four. All over for RCB? FUll on off, 142.4kph, squares Powell up. But he ends up getting a thick outside edge that beats short third
Toe-ends it for four! It was full and wide outside off, Powell reaches out at that but then thinks of leaving it be. But the ball goes between short third and backward point

Faf-tabulous catch! Motera roars! The RCB captain does it again. How? How does he do it repeatedly. Runs back from cover inside the circle, has his eyes on the ball ALL the time, settles under it and takes it with a tumble. Siraj had bowled it full, Hetmyer looked to flick it away but got a leading edge high in the air. RCB believe once more
Very full on off, knocked down to long-on
Full toss on middle, flicked to midwicket on the bounce
Angling in on a fullish length, flicked to fine leg, 139.1kph

Timberrr! Siraj breathes fire with a 139.6kph full one. Parag goes for the big shot but it sneaks through bat and pad. Siraj does his celebration, a forlorn Parag walks back without finishing the match
DIgs it short but it flies well over the batter's head. Parag leaves it but belatedly thinks of playing a ramp. RCB review the wide but it was well over
Sprayed down leg, Parag misses the flick
Very full on the leg, flicked through backward square leg
Slower one, angling away outside off, Parag swings and misses
Full on middle, slow again, flicked through midwicket
Slower one, but races away to the boundary. It was on a fullish length, Hetmyer goes hard at it and slices it over backward point. It was the back of the hand slower ball
Drilled back past the bowler. Dayal goes for the yorker, Hetmyer is deep in his crease. Clears his front leg and powers it down the ground
Low full toss, 102.6kph, swung away to deep midwicket
Slower short ball outside off, pulled on the bounce to deep midwicket
Short again, controlled pull to short midwicket
Back of a length on off, gets behind it and blocks
Smartly done, Parag! The back of a length ball has got Green immense success tonight. Sticks to it and angles it in at Parag, who backs away and ramps it over short third
Elegantly struck for a maximum! Green goes for another slower one. On a fullish length just outside off at 124.2kph. Parag backs away and swings his blade to tonk it well over covers
Full and wide outside off, heaved to long-on

Hetmyer connects! Did not look like that at first go. Back of a length ball, angling away, at 126.7kph, Hettie sits deep in his crease and heaves it across. Deep midwicket and long-on were briefly interested
Length ball on middle and leg, clipped through backward square leg
Bumper again, angling away from the batter, who lets it be
Top edge. Siraj bowls short, Hetmyer half-ducks and goes for the pull. Gets enough bat and it runs away to the fine leg ropes
Length ball on off, heaved to deep midwicket

Almost another run-out! Very full ball on middle, Parag plays the helicopter towards wide long-on. He doesn't want the second seeing du Plessis get to the ball. The throw is wide and DK collects and tries to hit the stumps but misses
Length ball on the body, tucked to fine leg
Full outside off, knocked down to long-off
Length ball outside off, wristed it through mid-on to keep strike
Length ball on off, punched back past the non-striker for a quick run
Back of a length around off, chopped to backward point
Another back of a length ball, punched through mid-on
Shortish on off, defended to the on side

Has Kohli conjured magic? A run-out appeal against Jurel referred upstairs. Short ball around off, pulled in front of square on the on side. Kohli gets quickly to his left and turns around and fires a throw to Green, the bowler, who disturbs the stumps while the batters were completing the second run. But Green does not seem to be in control/holding the ball. It is also touch-and-go for Jurel. His bat is jussssst outside when the stumps light up - he had hesitated a touch when going back for the second. But the main point in contention is if Green is in control of the ball while breaking the stumps. Third umpire Anil Chaudhary thinks so and Jurel is out of Motera!. His bat was only millimetres out of the crease when the stumps were disturbed.
Fuller outside off, crunched to deep cover
Back of a length around off, gets an inside edge onto the pad
Walloped! Back of a length outside off, Parag stands tall and heaves it well over deep midwicket. It was the knuckle ball and a half-tracker, really
Cuts the length ball outside off to deep third
Length ball on off and middle, defended towards midwicket
Full and just outside off, driven through covers. A half-stop means Lomror can get across from deep point
Length ball around off, defended to the on side
Back of a length outside off, steered it to deep third
Huge appeal from Green! DK did not hear anything but Green has convinced RCB to go for a review. Parag went for the pull but missed that. Nothing on Snicko, RCB lose a review
Very full on off, hit back to the bowler, who gets a hand to it
Length ball on off and middle, clipped through backward square leg. Kohli the fielder there, keeps it to one
Short and on the stumps, he sinks low to duck
Fuller outside off, eased to sweeper cover
Full n off, eased down to long-off
Throws it wider outside off, left alone. Wide called
Floated full on middle and leg, defended solidly
Deft, smart. Parag picks the googly early, gets across and paddles it fine. Would have been a dead duck had he missed
Fuller on the stumps, clipped through square leg
Off the mark in style. Flatter and on a length on off, Jurel goes back and whips it through midwicket to get going with a four

Stumped by a distance! Rush of blood from Samson. Karn anticipated the charge and threw it wide outside off. Samson dances down away from the line of the ball, in a bid to go inside out. Karthik collects it and whips the bails off in a flash
Length ball on middle, clipped to deep midwicket
Short and angling in, does not make good contact with the pull and only plays it towards forward square leg
Fuller on off and middle, he goes back and across and knocks it to long-on
Full and on the pads, worked away to fine leg

Green is confident, DK is confident but Jaiswal and the umpire are unmoved. DK signals the T and RCB review. Jaiswal looked to get across and scoop it over the keeper but did not make contact with the ball. But did the ball brush his glove? DK thinks so, Snicko confirms! Huge cheers ring across at the Motera and Jaiswal walks back. Green dropped him early, Green gets him now
SHortish length and angling in, pulled to deep backward square leg
Flatter and quicker on middle, Samson goes back and punches it to long-off
Fuller on leg, comes forward and flicks it through midwicket
Quicker and on a length on middle and leg, punched back to long-on
Flatter and on a length on middle, he goes back and whips it to deep midwicket
Floated full outside off, drilled through cover. Samson wanted two and was a few way down, but was sent back by Jaiswal, who is on his haunches
Fuller around off, whipped through wide mid-on. Kohli gets to it from long-on and keeps it to one, the crowd cheers
Full toss on middle and leg, whipped to deep midwicket
Back of a length angling away, slapped through forward point. Kohli the fielder charging in from sweeper cover, but Jaiswal takes him on and probably makes it, too. Replays confirm the same
Back of a length, angling in, nudged through to fine leg
Back of a length outside off, steered to deep third

The edge is Jaiswal's currency today. Ferguson goes full and angles it across off at 147.8kph. Jaiswal clears his front leg and looks to go over the top but gets a thick outside edge well past the wicketkeeper
On a length outside off, Samson glides it to deep third
Jaiswal in his elements. Superb use of the crease. Swapnil darts it short and wide outside off, he goes deep in the crease and cuts it well past backward point
Oh beautiful. Unfussed. Full and wide outside off, Jaiswal comes forward, gets on his knees and slaps it with a flat bat through cover. No chance for the sweeper
Tossed up full on off, eased through cover
Flatter and quicker on leg, flicked to long-on. 100.9kph
On a length on middle and leg, punched past the diving midwicket, even as DK yells from behind

Effortless, brilliant, maximum! This is from the Klaasen book of pull shot against spin from Samson. Swapnil lands it on a length, not too short, but Samson is quick to go back and heave it well over deep midwicket
Length ball on leg, driven back to him. Just two runs and a wicket off the last over of the powerplay
Length ball on middle, tucked away through forward square leg
Back of a length around off, he gets behind it and presents a solid defensive blade

Boooom! What a ball! The perfect yorker, at 125kph. It is the slower one again from Ferguson. The release was like a legcutter but it wasn't really one. It dipped as it reached Kohler-Cadmore, who looked to dig it out but was completely foxed. Ferguson leaps high and RCB celebrate
Back of a length on middle, hops and taps it to the off side for a quick run
Starts off with a low full toss, off-pace, flicked through midwicket
Finds the gap. Kohler-Cadmore backs away even as Dayal gets to the crease, lands it on a length on middle, He punches it perfectly past wide mid-off
Very full on leg, dug out to the off side

Smartly done this time. Another short ball outside leg. TKC backs away, transfers his weight back and heaves it again. This time, he is in better position and hits it over midwicket, well wide of Maxwell in the deep
Slower one, full on the pads, turned to midwicket
Fuller on the stumps, pushed towards mid-on

Maxwell drops Kohler-Cadmore! I cannot believe it even as I am typing it. Back of a length ball around middle and leg, he goes back and heaves it towards deep midwicket where Maxwell takes a few steps to his left but fails to hang on. Jersey No. 32 drops jersey No. 32
A yes-no call, after Jaiswal uppishly punches it past Siraj towards mid-on
Short and on leg, Swapnil misfields in the deep. A long hard stare from Siraj. Jaiswal pulls but gets it off the inner half. Deep backward square leg gets around and slides but fails to keep it in
Length ball on middle and leg, defended towards cover
Fuller around middle and leg, he looks to heave it across and gets an inside edge towards short fine leg
Classic shot through covers. Half-volley outside off, TKC leans into it and drills it through the gap
Oh what timing that is. Length ball on middle and leg, TKC stands tall and presents the full face of the bat in pushing it well past mid-on, where du Plessis' dive doesn't help either

Past Green again. Dayal cannot believe it and kicks the turf in anger. Length ball outside off, Jaiswal stays legside of the ball and only steers it past slip. It lands short of Green and goes well away from him despite the dive. Costly over for RCB
Crrrrunched! No half-measures there. Full and outside off, this time Jaiswal gets his front stride towards the line of the ball and leans into it, drives it through covers
Short and wide outside off, slashes and misses
Much better control. Short and outside off, Jaiswal stands tall and only steers it past short third

Dropped! Rub of the Green going Jaiswal's way, literally. Jaiswal goes hard at a full ball that is well wide outside off. But he is never near it. Gets a thick outside edge and Green, at wide slip, dives to his right but only parries it over the wicketkeeper
Swinging in from outside off, he leans forward and drives it to backward point
Another thick outside edge. Safe. Full and swinging away, Jaiswal goes for the lofted off drive but slices it towards short third
Angling in on a length on the pads, he misses the flick. It lobs off the pad towards square leg
Length ball on middle, he stands legside and looks to turn it away but gets it towards midwicket
Swinging in from outside off, low full toss around off, pushed towards mid-off
Sliced off the outside edge. Full and swinging away again, 138.3kph, TKC goes hard at it and gets it to deep third
Full and outside off, a hint of swing away, not much of a footwork from TKC as he drives it towards mid-off
Fuller and angling away, once again he moves back and across and eases it towards mid-off. Good start from Swapnil
Charges down the track and hoicks it to deep midwicket
On a length around off, punched towards short cover
Quicker and outside off, on a length, gets a thicksh outside edge towards short third
Quicker and fuller around off, hurries Jaiswal into pushing it to mid-off
Fuller around off, moves back and across and pushes it to mid-off
